about_the_game:
Welcome to Chirpvenience! is a short, heartwarming, and cheerful light interactive visual novel.

There are no complex choices and no time pressure—
you simply follow the story in a relaxed first-person perspective,
experiencing a gentle week of convenience store life that begins with you.

As a short-term clerk in the quiet and adorable town of Larktown,
you’ll handle restocking, checkout, chatting, and small unexpected events,
interacting with a variety of customers and coworkers while enjoying a humorous and soothing daily routine.

After moving to Larktown, you start a very short-term job at Chirpvenience.

Within the gentle rhythm of this small town, you’ll encounter checkout tasks, restocking, conversations, and little moments of surprise—
gradually forming natural and easygoing connections with the people around you.

Working alongside your fun coworkers and the kind store manager,
your days slowly become familiar and comforting through teamwork, conversations,
and the simple act of looking out for one another.
Before you know it, Chirpvenience becomes the starting point of your new life in this town.

Students, office workers, regular customers—
every day, different people pass by in their own quiet ways.
There are no dramatic adventures here,
but you’ll find adorable characters, gentle pacing, and a calming everyday atmosphere.

It feels as though someone has quietly saved a little place in this town just for you.

Single-path story with a gentle pace

Friendly for newcomers and completely stress-free—perfect for relaxing or enjoying a short narrative experience.

Charming coworkers and townsfolk

Each character has a distinct personality and speaking style,
making everyday conversations the heart of the story’s charm.

The Convenience Encyclopedia: Collect small items and unlock hidden details

During your shifts, you’ll gather various everyday objects and cute notes,
gradually revealing hidden tidbits and secrets around Chirpvenience.

Visual novel × light convenience-store simulation

Simple interactive elements—restocking, checkout, and shop tasks—
let you casually enjoy the fun of working as a store clerk at a comfortable pace.

Free to play × multi-language support

Currently supports Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese,
with the possibility of adding more languages in the future.

This is a small, easy-going game.

If you’re looking to relax or take a short break,

you’re welcome to clock in at Chirpvenience.
